headline: Ministry of Finance Launches New Tezaur Edition on Monday with Tax-Free Interest of Up to 7.15% per Year. How to Buy Government Securities
summary: The Ministry of Finance launches the eighth edition of this year's Tezaur program on Monday, August 10. It offers individuals tax-free interest of up to 7.15% a year.
why: Tezaur bonds are retail government securities in Romania, and their yields signal the sovereign's domestic funding costs and the local rate environment.
